title: Tabular foundation models vs tuned trees on small data (CPU, 100 to 2,000 rows)
description: Learning-curve benchmark of four tabular foundation models (Kumo-Tabular, Causilo, FTFM-1, LightPFN) against random forest, HistGradientBoosting and a 20-config tuned XGBoost on six UCI datasets (CC BY 4.0), 2-core CPU, 3 GB memory cap. Code, results and charts. Model weights are not included and keep their own licences.
